statement: The prepared fixed-instance IC panel completed all 48 paired cases and 12 same-target rho reference records. All 96 pipeline answers and non-timing paired counts agree with their frozen inputs. Raw cold reference/direct medians for N15 are 1.037624 Buchberger, 1.066591 F4, 1.106034 wide FES, 1.005862 MITM; N18 gives 0.999717, 1.030510, 1.050697 and 1.004081. MITM is the fastest tested method on these bases. One A/A calibration bound fails. All timings remain unqualified and this does not establish a performance breakthrough over the best tested IC pipeline.
